items.title: Under the Wave off Kanagawa
items.series: Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjūrokkei)
items.description_narrative: A monstrous wave curls into claw-like foam above three slender boats, their rowers bent low against the swell. Far below the towering crest, a small snow-capped peak stands calm on the horizon.
items.tags: great wave, kanagawa, hokusai, mount fuji, boats, ukiyo-e

items.title: Fine Wind, Clear Morning (Red Fuji)
items.description_narrative: A rust-red Mount Fuji streaked with snow rises above dark green forested foothills beneath a deep blue sky ribbed with white cirrus clouds. No figures or buildings appear; the mountain fills nearly the whole right side of the sheet.
items.tags: ukiyo-e, mount fuji, red fuji, landscape, hokusai, clouds
items.credit_line: JgGlXuCNoGIpzg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Ejiri in Suruga Province
items.description_narrative: Travelers clutch at their hats and robes as a fierce gust bends roadside trees and sends loose papers scattering across a coastal path, one man chasing a runaway sheet. The scene depicts wind sweeping travelers near Mount Fuji, visible pale in the distance.
items.tags: ukiyo-e, wind, mount fuji, travelers, hokusai, tokaido
items.credit_line: http://visipix.com/index.htm

items.title: Kajikazawa in Kai Province
items.description_narrative: A fisherman balances on a rocky point casting a net into choppy waves, a child crouched low beside him, as snow-capped Mount Fuji rises calm and distant across the water. The taut lines of the net echo the curves of the waves below.
items.tags: mount fuji, fisherman, casting net, rocky point, hokusai
items.credit_line: http://visipix.com/index.htm

items.title: Sudden Shower over Shin-Ōhashi Bridge and Atake
items.description_narrative: Pedestrians hurry across a long wooden bridge under heavy slanting rain, some sheltering beneath straw hats and umbrellas, while a lone boatman poles a raft across the river below. Utagawa Hiroshige made this print of a sudden shower over the Sumida River in 1857.
items.tags: ukiyo-e, hiroshige, rain, bridge, edo period, landscape
items.credit_line: This image is available from the United States Library of Congress's Prints and Photographs division under the digital ID jpd.02950.This tag does not indicate the copyright status of the attached work. A normal copyright tag is still required. See Commons:Licensing.

items.title: Plum Park in Kameido
items.description_narrative: A gnarled black plum trunk fills the foreground at a dramatic close angle, its white blossoms scattered against a sky graded from pink to deep violet. Beyond a low fence, tourists stroll through an orchard of slender plum trees in the middle distance.
items.tags: plum blossoms, orchard, tree trunk, tourists, hiroshige, woodblock print
items.credit_line: PAFEe4QeeBnqpw at Google Cultural Institute, zoom level maximum

items.title: Evening Snow at Kanbara
items.description_narrative: Three bundled travelers trudge single file through deep snow past thatched village roofs in a valley beneath snow-covered mountains. The print, now in the Metropolitan Museum of Art, depicts a mountain landscape under snow.
items.tags: ukiyo-e, kanbara, snow, tokaido, hiroshige, winter
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art. See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy

items.title: Three Beauties of the Present Day
items.description_narrative: Three women's faces crowd close together in an intimate composition, their elaborate hairstyles bristling with ornamental combs and pins. One holds a round fan stamped with a floral crest, her sidelong gaze meeting the viewer's.
items.tags: utamaro, bijin-ga, beauties, japanese print, portrait
items.credit_line: cgH3Mn22MIBngA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Takiyasha the Witch and the Skeleton Spectre
items.description_narrative: A colossal skeleton looms across three panels, its ribcage and skull stark white against a black void, as armored warriors below raise weapons against it. At left, a woman in a flowing robe unrolls a scroll of incantation beside a torn bamboo blind.
items.tags: kuniyoshi, skeleton, triptych, gashadokuro, takiyasha, ukiyo-e, supernatural
items.credit_line: https://www.britishmuseum.org/collection/object/A_1915-0823-0-915-916

items.title: Fuji from Gotenyama at Shinagawa on the Tōkaidō
items.cultural_context: Japanese, Edo period; from Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji
items.medium: Woodblock print, ink and color on paper
items.description_narrative: Blossoming trees frame a distant blue-and-white snow-capped peak across the bay, picnicking groups seated on red mats and gathered at a teahouse on the hill in the foreground. Figures with fans and bundles cluster near the teahouse steps.
items.tags: ukiyo-e, gotenyama, mount fuji, cherry blossom, hokusai, tokaido
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art. See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy

items.title: Watermill at Onden
items.cultural_context: Japanese, Edo period; from Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji
items.medium: Woodblock print, ink and color on paper
items.description_narrative: A massive wooden waterwheel churns beside a thatched mill house, workers stooping to sift grain in baskets below its dripping paddles. A tiny turtle creeps across the foreground while a snow-capped peak rises pale on the horizon.
items.tags: watermill, onden, hokusai, mount fuji, edo, thirty-six views
items.credit_line: Source: http://visipix.com/index.htm

items.title: Shōno: Driving Rain
items.cultural_context: Japanese, Edo period; from The Fifty-Three Stations of the Tōkaidō
items.medium: Woodblock print, ink and color on paper
items.description_narrative: Travelers bend double and hurry down a slope as sheets of rain slash the sky in steep diagonal lines, straw capes and wide hats their only shelter. Bamboo bows flat in the wind behind them, its silhouette fading into gray bands of distant rain.
items.tags: tokaido, rain, storm, travelers, shono, hiroshige, woodblock print
items.credit_line: https://clevelandart.org/art/1948.306

items.title: Yui: Satta Pass
items.cultural_context: Japanese, Edo period; from The Fifty-Three Stations of the Tōkaidō
items.medium: Woodblock print, ink and color on paper
items.description_narrative: Tiny travelers pick their way along a narrow cliffside trail, pines clinging to the rock face above crashing waves. Across the bay, sailboats dot the water beneath a snow-capped peak glowing in soft pink light. Commons records the pass by its old name, the Frightful Satta Pass.
items.tags: mountain pass, cliffside trail, coastal view, tokaido, travelers, seascape
items.credit_line: Hood Museum of Art, Dartmouth College

items.title: Fireworks at Ryōgoku
items.cultural_context: Japanese, Edo period; from One Hundred Famous Views of Edo
items.medium: Woodblock print, ink and color on paper
items.description_narrative: Fireworks burst across nearly half the deep indigo night sky above the crowded bridge below, small boats clustered beneath it and along the dark riverbank. The composition, now in the Cleveland Museum of Art, gives the sky more space than the bridge itself.
items.tags: ukiyo-e, ryogoku, fireworks, night scene, hiroshige, bridge
items.credit_line: https://clevelandart.org/art/1940.986

items.title: Kinryūzan Temple, Asakusa
items.cultural_context: Japanese, Edo period; from One Hundred Famous Views of Edo
items.medium: Woodblock print, ink and color on paper
items.description_narrative: A great red lantern looms directly overhead as snow falls thickly on the temple grounds below, where huddled figures with umbrellas pass a snow-blanketed pagoda and temple hall. Deep blue night sky and drifting snowflakes fill the space between.
items.tags: giant lantern, snow, pagoda, temple grounds, night sky
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art. See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy

items.title: Naniwaya Okita
items.medium: Woodblock print, ink and color on paper
items.description_narrative: A young woman glances back over her shoulder, her hair swept into a high, elaborately pinned coiffure held with a yellow comb and red cord. She wears a green kimono patterned with pale blossoms over a red under-robe, balancing a black lacquer tray with a teacup in one hand.
items.tags: bijin-ga, portrait, kimono, teacup, utamaro, woodblock print, hairstyle
items.credit_line: http://free-artworks.gatag.net/2013/11/25/200000.html

items.title: Zhang Shun, the White Stripe in the Waves
items.cultural_context: Japanese, Edo period; from One Hundred and Eight Heroes of the Water Margin
items.medium: Woodblock print, ink and color on paper
items.description_narrative: A muscular, heavily tattooed warrior grips a sword between his teeth as he surges through crashing waves, arrows bristling around him. Thick rope and a carved dragon figurehead frame the action. The tattoos covering his body identify him as one of the Water Margin's storied heroes.
items.tags: tattooed warrior, water margin, sword, waves, action scene, japanese legend
items.credit_line: NQGOOR5RX6IlWg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Moon on Musashi Plain
items.cultural_context: Japanese, Meiji period; from One Hundred Aspects of the Moon
items.medium: Woodblock print, ink and color on paper
items.description_narrative: A fox sits hunched in a patch of tall grass, glancing back over its shoulder beneath a large, softly glowing full moon. The muted grey and cream palette gives the scene a hushed, nocturnal stillness.
items.tags: fox, full moon, grass, nocturnal, yoshitoshi
items.credit_line: jAHH0A04avBLOg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Tsuchigumo (The Ground Spider)
items.description_narrative: A monstrous, wide-eyed creature looms from the shadows, its clawed hands casting a vast white web over a seated warrior. He grips his sword with both hands, sleeve slipping to reveal a bloodstained leg against the red and green mat below.
items.tags: yoshitoshi, tsuchigumo, ground spider, warrior, supernatural, ukiyo-e

items.title: Woman Passing a Roadside Shop Near Oji
items.description_narrative: A woman with a child strapped to her back walks beside a companion along a riverside path shaded by tall trees. Nearby, a vendor tends small wares laid on a low table, while children carrying baskets on poles pass a moored boat.
items.tags: oji, roadside shop, hokusai, edo, riverside, travelers
items.credit_line: https://clevelandart.org/art/1916.1133

items.title: Kamakura no Gengoro Seizing Torinoumi Tasaburo
items.description_narrative: Set against a deep indigo ground, two armored warriors grapple fiercely, one gripping the other's topknot while crossed swords cut diagonally through the composition. Elaborate armor patterns and streaming cords fill nearly every inch of the design.
items.tags: warriors, combat scene, armor, indigo ground, dramatic composition
items.credit_line: https://clevelandart.org/art/1916.1169

items.title: Women and Children Walking Along the Sumida River
items.description_narrative: Two women and two children make their way along a riverbank path, one shading herself with a wide lacquered hat, another carrying a folding fan; a boy behind them totes a bundle wrapped around a leafy branch. Banners and rooftops rise across the water. The scene captures everyday genre life of Edo-period Japan.
items.tags: riverside, genre scene, edo period, woodblock print, family, daily life
items.credit_line: https://clevelandart.org/art/1943.2

items.title: Group of Figures near a Brook
items.description_narrative: In muted sepia and green tones, a woman carries a child past two men in traveling robes beneath tall trees, while another woman kneels at a low table nearby and two children hurry off carrying baskets. A brook and distant shoreline recede softly behind the group.
items.tags: figures, brook, muted palette, travelers, children, hokusai
items.credit_line: https://clevelandart.org/art/1916.937

items.title: The Six Immortal Poets (Rokkasen)
items.description_narrative: Six seated figures in patterned court robes are grouped closely together, holding fans and papers, rendered in fine ink outline with muted color washes. Kitagawa Utamaro made this print of the Six Immortal Poets (Rokkasen) around 1795; it is held by the Library of Congress.
items.tags: ukiyo-e, utamaro, woodblock print, poets, edo period, japanese art

items.title: Rice Planters
items.description_narrative: A large wooden waterwheel turns beside a footbridge where a man braces long poles against the current. Nearby, women pause among the paddies with baskets and umbrellas, thatched haystacks and a gnarled tree closing the scene at right.
items.tags: rice paddies, waterwheel, farmers, countryside, hokusai, woodblock print
items.credit_line: https://hdl.handle.net/10934/RM0001.collect.45676

items.title: Sailing on the Sumida River
items.description_narrative: Pleasure boats crowd the river beneath red lanterns strung along a riverside teahouse, one vessel carrying a potted pine and reclining passengers. Smaller roofed boats and a distant bridge complete the scene under a pale, hazy sky.
items.tags: river, pleasure boats, lanterns, bonsai, teahouse, hokusai, woodblock print
items.credit_line: http://hdl.handle.net/10934/RM0001.collect.45680

items.title: Balloon Flower and Dragonfly
items.description_narrative: A large dragonfly with translucent, outstretched wings hovers above a spray of pale mauve and white bell-shaped blossoms, rendered against a plain, unshaded background. Dense green leaves fill out the plant below, each vein carefully outlined.
items.tags: ukiyo-e, woodblock print, flower and insect study, dragonfly, botanical print
items.credit_line: http://hdl.handle.net/10934/RM0001.collect.47668

items.title: Battling Warriors
items.description_narrative: Two elaborately armored warriors grapple at close range, one gripping the other's helmet and forcing him down while a long sword cuts diagonally across the composition. Intricate patterns of lacquered plates and cord lacing fill nearly every inch of the deep blue background.
items.tags: ukiyo-e, woodblock print, hokusai, warriors, combat, armor
items.credit_line: http://hdl.handle.net/10934/RM0001.COLLECT.47667

items.title: Shishi (Lion-Dog)
items.description_narrative: A mythical shishi crouches amid swirling clouds, its mane rendered in dense spiral curls and its plumed tail arcing above its back. A red seal marks the lower corner of the otherwise monochrome sheet.
items.tags: shishi, lion-dog, mythical creature, clouds, monochrome, japanese print
items.credit_line: Library of Congress Catalog: https://lccn.loc.gov/2008660600 Image download: https://cdn.loc.gov/service/pnp/jpd/01900/01973v.jpg Original url: https://www.loc.gov/pictures/item/2008660600/

items.title: Two Women with a Doll
items.description_narrative: Two women lean over a low pink railing, their sleek hairstyles and patterned robes rendered in fine detail. Between them sits a doll-like figure in a blue-green striped robe, its hair styled in a matching topknot.
items.tags: bijin-ga, doll, japanese print, portrait, edo
items.credit_line: http://hdl.handle.net/10934/RM0001.COLLECT.1710

items.title: Playing Sugoroku in the Third Month (Yayoi)
items.description_narrative: A group gathers on a veranda around a game board spread on a mat, kneeling figures in layered robes leaning in to play while a woman stands nearby with a tray held high. A small child crouches at the edge, a landscaped garden visible through the open doorway behind them.
items.tags: sugoroku, game, veranda, kimono, garden, hokusai, woodblock print
items.credit_line: Own work

items.title: Man Lifting a Sake Barrel
items.description_narrative: A muscular man in a striped loincloth hoists a large sake barrel high overhead with one arm, his whole body braced against the weight. Drawn in ink with only sparse color, the figure's strain is captured in the sharp lines of his stretched arm and twisted torso.
items.tags: strongman, sake barrel, feat of strength, sparse color
items.credit_line: Library of Congress Catalog: https://lccn.loc.gov/2009615559 Image download: https://cdn.loc.gov/service/pnp/jpd/00500/00589v.jpg Original url: https://www.loc.gov/pictures/item/2009615559/

items.title: The Mirror Polisher (Kagamitogi)
items.description_narrative: Two women hold large stylized puppet heads close together, one an elderly bald man with bushy eyebrows and the other a younger painted face, acting out a comic scene. Behind them, smaller figures peer out in hooded travel dress.
items.tags: hand puppets, comic performance, kyogen, portraiture
items.credit_line: http://hdl.handle.net/10934/RM0001.COLLECT.45670

items.title: Chinese Boys Learning to Write and Paint
items.description_narrative: In a furnished interior, children in patterned Chinese-style robes gather around a low lacquered table strewn with brushes and scrolls, one bent over a sheet in mid-stroke. A framed landscape hangs on the wall behind a cabinet stacked with boxes.
items.tags: ukiyo-e, interior scene, calligraphy, children, hokusai, genre

items.title: Nanukayo (The Seventh Night)
items.description_narrative: Curling waves and foam spray fill the sheet in energetic swirling lines, rendered entirely in black ink without color. Two columns of loosely rippling water dominate the composition, evoking motion and turbulence with calligraphic economy.
items.tags: waves, ink drawing, hokusai, monochrome, water study, seascape

items.title: Imadogawa
items.description_narrative: Two workers crouch over dark objects set on low tables beside a thatched riverside shelter, a gnarled tree and drying racks nearby. Small boats drift on the river behind them, with houses and trees lining the far bank.
items.tags: riverside, workers, thatched shelter, boats, hokusai
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art. See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy

items.description_narrative: Snow-covered timber stacks lean diagonally across a dark starry sky above lumber-filled canals, a straw-covered mound and a small dog in the foreground. Workers pole rafts of lumber through the snowy water below.

items.description_narrative: Seen from above, the river beneath the bridge fills with narrow boats carrying rows of red-clad passengers, weaving between snow-dusted rooftops and market stalls. A pale, snow-capped peak floats above a band of red dawn cloud, the bridge itself lined with tiny figures.

items.description_narrative: A pale crescent moon hangs in a star-flecked night sky above dark water, a massive bridge pier looming at left. Ranks of masted boats stand silent at anchor while two small flames flicker orange on the tide.

items.title: Ueno Yamashita
items.description_narrative: A flock of small birds wheels across a rose-tinted sky above a bustling shopping street lined with red lanterns and indigo banners. A loaded packhorse and crowds of pedestrians fill the road, while a cluster of open umbrellas crowds the lower corner.

items.title: Mount Atago in Shiba
items.description_narrative: A costumed figure in dark robes and a feathered headdress holds an oversized wooden shamoji, standing beneath the shrine's red veranda beams. Below, the bay opens out to distant sails and fluttering banners, the view framed by a steep pine-covered slope.

items.title: Night View of Matsuchiyama and the San'ya Canal
items.description_narrative: A woman in a plaid robe and patterned black wrap strolls a riverside path beneath a star-scattered night sky, her wooden sandals clicking along the shore. Lit boats glow faintly across the dark water, a lone bare tree rising at the picture's edge.

items.description_narrative: A great dark curved shape frames a glimpse of open river beyond, as if seen through a torn net or window. Plum blossoms trail across the opening while boatmen pole small craft and a skein of birds threads the pale evening sky.

items.description_narrative: A single large, twisting pine dominates a hilltop overlooking a bay dotted with sailboats. Below it, travelers rest at a small teahouse, porters carry loads by pole and palanquin, and terraced rice fields spread out toward the water under a red horizon.
